description: Search approved macro layout blocks by query, role, family, or tag. Optional design/page/slot context filters to slot-compatible roles. Returns summaries and immutable refs only; use cursors for more.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor returned from a previous search.

designId.description: Active design session ID to search with session-specific block registry overrides.

limit.description: Maximum number of block manifests to return per page (1-32, default 10).

pageId.description: Target page ID in the design session when scoping to a slot.

parentNodeId.description: Parent node ID hosting the target slot.

q.description: Full-text search query across macro block IDs, descriptions, and tag sets.

slotId.description: Target parent slot ID to filter compatible blocks by role.

tag.description: Specific functional tag to filter by (e.g. "sidebar", "data-table", "kpi").

name: search_macro_blocks
